```python\n       def compute_attention_importance_probe(img_embs, lang_emb, lm, n_probe_layers=2):\n           \"\"\"Importance = avg attention from language tokens -> each vision token\"\"\"\n           import torch.nn.functional as F\n           from transformers.models.gemma import modeling_gemma as _gemma\n           all_vis = torch.cat(img_embs, dim=1)\n           total_vis = all_vis.shape[1]\n           full_embs = torch.cat([all_vis, lang_emb], dim=1)\n           B, S, D = full_embs.shape\n           position_ids = torch.arange(S, device=full_embs.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1)\n           hidden = full_embs\n           all_attn = []\n           with torch.no_grad():\n               for layer_idx in range(min(n_probe_layers, len(lm.layers))):\n                   layer = lm.layers[layer_idx]\n                   normed = layer.input_layernorm(hidden)\n                   head_dim = layer.self_attn.head_dim\n                   q = layer.self_attn.q_proj(normed)\n                   k = layer.self_attn.k_proj(normed)\n                   v = layer.self_attn.v_proj(normed)\n                   n_q_heads = q.shape[-1] // head_dim\n                   n_kv_heads = k.shape[-1] // head_dim\n                   q = q.view(B, S, n_q_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)\n                   k = k.view(B, S, n_kv_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)\n                   v = v.view(B, S, n_kv_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)\n                   cos, sin = lm.rotary_emb(v, position_ids)\n                   q, k = _gemma.apply_rotary_pos_emb(q, k, cos, sin, unsqueeze_dim=1)\n                   if n_kv_heads != n_q_heads:\n                       n_rep = n_q_heads // n_kv_heads\n                       k = k.repeat_interleave(n_rep, dim=1)\n                       v = v.repeat_interleave(n_rep, dim=1)\n                   scaling = layer.self_attn.scaling\n                   attn_weights = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) * scaling\n                   attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32)\n                   all_attn.append(attn_weights)\n                   attn_out = torch.matmul(attn_weights.to(v.dtype), v)\n                   attn_out = attn_out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, n_q_heads * head_dim)\n                   attn_out = layer.self_attn.o_proj(attn_out)\n                   hidden = hidden + attn_out\n                   normed2 = layer.post_attention_layernorm(hidden)\n                   mlp_out = layer.mlp(normed2)\n {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.\n\nSummary:\n1. Primary Request and Intent:\n   Implement Attention-based Vision Token Pruning (`--prune_mode attention` / `--mode attention_prune`) for three VLA model eval scripts: π0.5, OpenVLA, and SmolVLA. The goal is to prove that regardless of importance metric (random, l2norm, or attention), CV (coefficient of variation) can predict pruning tolerance. This is marked P1 urgent. The implementation adds a 2-layer LLM attention probe to score vision token importance and prune low-scoring tokens (true_removal mode). Dry-run validation with 2 episodes is required for each model.\n\n2. Key Technical Concepts:\n   - **Vision Token Pruning**: Removing low-importance vision tokens before LLM processing\n   - **2-layer attention probe**: Manually running embeddings through first 2 LLM layers to extract attention weights\n   - **π0.5 architecture**: PaliGemma (SigLIP + Gemma 2B), pruning via monkey-patched `embed_prefix`, uses Gemma's `apply_rotary_pos_emb` and `layer.self_attn.scaling`\n   - **OpenVLA architecture**: Llama-2 LLM with PrismaticProjector, hook-based pruning on `vla.projector`, uses `rotate_half` for RoPE, accesses `vla.language_model.model.layers`\n   - **SmolVLA architecture**: SmolVLMModel (SigLIP + Llama3-like text model), hook-based pruning on connector. **Critical**: LLM layers are at `vlm.text_model.layers` NOT `vlm.layers`, and rotary_emb at `vlm.text_model.rotary_emb`\n   - **GQA handling**: All models use grouped-query attention requiring KV head expansion via `repeat_interleave`\n   - **Importance scoring**: π0.5 uses language→vision cross-attention (full sequence available), OpenVLA/SmolVLA use vision self-attention (only vision tokens in hook)\n   - **Server topology**: Different models run on different AutoDL servers\n\n3. Files and Code Sections:\n\n   - **`/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515-2/projects/importance_margin_vla_compress/artifacts/patch_pi05.py`** (LOCAL)\n     - Patch script that adds `compute_attention_importance_probe()` and `pruned_embed_prefix_attn()` monkey-patch to π0.5 eval\n     - Applied successfully to `westd-41074`\n\n   - **`/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515-2/projects/importance_margin_vla_compress/artifacts/patch_openvla.py`** (LOCAL)\n     - Adds `AttentionPruningHook` class using Llama-style RoPE (`rotate_half`) and `vla.language_model.model` for LLM layers\n     - Applied successfully to `westd-27271`\n\n   - **`/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515-2/projects/importance_margin_vla_compress/artifacts/patch_smolvla.py`** (LOCAL)\n     - Adds `register_attention_prune_hook()` function. **NOTE**: The local artifact has a bug - uses `vlm.layers` which should be `vlm.text_model.layers`. The fix was applied on-server but NOT to this local file.\n\n   - **`/root/autodl-tmp/importance_margin_vla_compress/eval_pi05_pruning_libero.py`** (SERVER: westd-41074)\n     - Patched successfully. Key additions at lines 80 (`compute_attention_importance_probe`) and 237 (call site)\n     - `--prune_mode attention` added as choice, separate `pruned_embed_prefix_attn` monkey-patch block\n\n   - **`/root/autodl-tmp/importance_margin_vla_compress/eval_openvla_l2norm_libero.py`** (SERVER: westd-27271)\n     - Patched successfully. `AttentionPruningHook` at line 167, hook registration at line 286\n     - `--mode attention_prune` added as choice, output filename and k_ratio handling updated\n\n   - **`/root/autodl-tmp/importance_margin_vla_compress/eval_smolvla_pruning_official.py`** (SERVER: westd-27271)\n     - Patched AND hotfixed. `register_attention_prune_hook` at line 203, eval loop at line 439\n     - Hotfix changed `vlm.layers` → `lm.layers` (where `lm = vlm.text_model`) and `vlm.rotary_emb` → `lm.rotary_emb` at line 220\n\n   - **`/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515-2/config/resources.yaml`**\n     - Server configuration showing available servers: cqa1-33015, westd-27271, westd-38929, westd-41074\n     - westd-41074 and westd-38929 use conda env_activate\n\n4. Errors and fixes:\n   - **Server name \"A6000\" no longer valid**: Available servers changed. Fixed by reading resources.yaml and checking for .bak files to identify target servers. π0.5 → westd-41074, OpenVLA/SmolVLA → westd-27271.\n   - **OpenVLA/SmolVLA files not on westd-41074**: These files only exist on westd-27271. Fixed by uploading patches to the correct server.\n   - **OpenVLA ImportError `PaddingStrategy`**: Pre-existing env issue - `/root/autodl-tmp/openvla_deps` directory doesn't exist on westd-27271. `sys.path.insert(0, \"/root/autodl-tmp/openvla_deps\")` in the script points to missing deps. \"\"\"Attention-based pruning: 2-layer self-attention probe among vision tokens.\"\"\"\n    import math\n    call_count = [0]\n\n    def hook_fn(module, input, output):\n        import torch.nn.functional as F\n\n        tokens = output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output\n        if tokens.dim() != 3:\n            return output\n        B, N, D = tokens.shape\n        k =           layer = vlm.layers[layer_idx]\n                normed = layer.input_layernorm(hidden)\n\n                head_dim = layer.self_attn.head_dim\n                q = layer.self_attn.q_proj(normed)\n                k_proj = layer.self_attn.k_proj(normed)\n                v = layer.self_attn.v_proj(normed)\n\n                n_q_heads = q.shape[-1] // head_dim\n                n_kv_heads = k_proj.shape[-1] // head_dim\n\n                q = q.view(B, N, n_q_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)\n                k_proj = k_proj.view(B, N, n_kv_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)\n                v = v.view(B, N, n_kv_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)\n\n                cos, sin = vlm.rotary_emb(v, position_ids)\n                from transformers.models.llama.modeling_llama import rotate_half\n                q_embed = (q * cos) + (rotate_half(q) * sin)\n                k_embed = (k_proj * cos) + (rotate_half(k_proj) * sin)\n\n                if n_kv_heads != n_q_heads:\n                    n_rep = n_q_heads // n_kv_heads\n                    k_embed = k_embed.repeat_interleave(n_rep, dim=1)\n                    v = v.repeat_interleave(n_rep, dim=1)\n\n                attn_weights = torch.matmul(q_embed, k_embed.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(head_dim)\n                attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32)\n                all_attn.append(attn_weights)\n\n                attn_out = torch.matmul(attn_weights.to(v.dtype), v)\n                attn_out = attn_out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, n_q_heads * head_dim)\n                attn_out = layer.self_attn.o_proj(attn_out)\n                hidden = hidden + attn_out\n\n                normed2 = layer.post_attention_layernorm(hidden)\n                mlp_out = layer.mlp(normed2)\n                hidden = hidden + mlp_out\n\n        avg_attn = torch.stack(all_attn).mean(dim=0).mean(dim=1)  # topk_idx_sorted.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, D))\n        else:\n            mask = torch.zeros(B, N, dtype=torch.bool, device=tokens.device)\n            mask.scatter_(1, topk_idx_sorted, True)\n            pruned = tokens.clone()\n            pruned[~mask] = 0\n\n        if isinstance(output, tuple):\n            return (pruned,) + output[1:]\n        return pruned\n\n    return
